plans.idea: Keep the original's order from top to bottom: the Quillbrook badge centred at the top, the bottle as the centred hero, then a full-width text block, the centred button, and a small line of fine print at the bottom, all on one centre line.

Put the headline first: a small badge, then the large headline and subheadline at the top, the bottle in the middle as the visual payoff, and the button at the bottom, so it reads like a story from top to bottom.
An editorial split: the tall bottle fills a left column next to the stacked copy on the right, with the badge above it and a full-width button across the bottom to anchor the page.
